lines.text: He turns a cheap purple bike into a motorbike with a 120 dollar engine kit.
The box has an 80cc two stroke engine and a gas tank that came already dented.
A two stroke fires on every turn of the crank instead of every other one so a tiny engine still makes real power.
beats: ai:cutaway of a small two stroke engine with the piston firing and a bright spark

lines.text: He bolts a big sprocket to the back wheel and has to shim it with zip ties which is how you know it's a 120 dollar kit.
Then the engine goes in the frame and the clutch and throttle go on the handlebar.
The fuel is mixed 18 to 1 with oil because a two stroke has no oil pan so the gas has to carry the oil.
beats: ai:cutaway of a two stroke piston with a fine golden oil mist in the fuel

lines.text: There's no starter so you pedal and drop the clutch which turns your legs into the starter motor.
And it fires up and cruises at 22 to 25 miles per hour.
It topped out at 31 but it shakes a lot because a cheap one cylinder engine isn't balanced very well.
Still that's way faster than anyone can pedal for long so 120 dollars buys a lot of fun.
